reason: The first control sandbox was a Git worktree with research/records deleted but uncommitted. Its git status exposed deleted record pathnames. Participant C2 explicitly used those pathnames for Q5, so both first-round control runs are excluded before scoring.

corrected_control.boundary: Independent materialized Git repository with no research/records files or prior index commits. Legacy research ledger, F01 reports and F01 result document are byte-identical to the index arm.
corrected_control.known_limitation: This materialized control repository does not contain the old Trade Git commit graph; its docs and manifests still state the historical source IDs. The difference is disclosed when interpreting Q7.
